record_type: aggregate diagnostic measurements transcribed from executed console output
scope: Read-only diagnosis before rule-policy fixes; no RL runs or simulation changes

configuration.source: Current local defaults in src/alive/environment/scenarios.py and resolver.py
configuration.code_revision: Uncommitted local implementation; no immutable code snapshot attached

method: run_episode(RuleAgent() or RandomAgent(), scenario_by_name(stable or scarcity), seed) for seeds 0..19; additional stable Rules episode at seed 42. Aggregates are rounded as printed in the diagnostic output.
limitations: No complete per-run traces or immutable configuration/code snapshot preserved for this initial batch.
A future before/after evaluation must preserve those artifacts.
These measurements do not prove the entire world is unsustainable, evaluate RL, or establish future individual-agent feasibility on specific hardware.
